values.note: $10 a night for a dry space; $25 a night for one of the three sites with 30-amp electric and water.

fees.source: https://townofdrummondmt.gov/park-facilities (Camping Fee Schedule: '3 camping sites with 30 amp electricity and water hook-up; cost of $25.00 per night/per location', 'an additional 10 dry camping spaces; cost of $10.00 per night/per location'; page ©2026), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://townofdrummondmt.gov/park-facilities ('3 camping sites with 30 amp electricity and water hook-up') + https://townofdrummondmt.gov/locations-and-directions ('three pull through spots for RVs with water and electricity'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Town's two pages differ on the count: three pull-through water/electric RV spots plus seven pull-in tent/RV spots without hookups (locations page), or 3 hookup sites plus 10 dry camping spaces (fee schedule). All camp spots have fire pits.

sites.source: https://townofdrummondmt.gov/locations-and-directions ('three pull through spots for RVs with water and electricity. There are seven pull in spots for tents or RVs without water and electricity') + https://townofdrummondmt.gov/park-facilities ('3 camping sites ...', 'an additional 10 dry camping spaces'), read 2026-10-22; the derived 23-ft maximum came from The Dyrt and no Town page states a length, so it is cleared

values.note: Water is turned off during the freezing months, typically October through May; the Town's banner says 'WATER IS CURRENTLY OFF AT THE CITY PARK/CAMPGROUND' (read 2026-10-22).

facilities.source: https://townofdrummondmt.gov/park-facilities ('No, The Town of Drummond does not have RV dumping available.' 'the water is turned off during the freezing months, typically October through May'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Open year round, but the water is off in the freezing months, typically October through May.

season.source: https://townofdrummondmt.gov/park-facilities ('Yes, the Drummond City Park/Campground is open year round. However, the water is turned off during the freezing months, typically October through May.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://townofdrummondmt.gov/park-facilities ('No, The Drummond Campground does not accept reservations for camping. Camping is on a first come, first serve basis; with a maximum stay of 3 (three) nights.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Town of Drummond city park and campground right along the Clark Fork River (7 Fairgrounds Loop, off I-90 exit 154), under large shade trees; playground, ballfield, boat launch and fishing access. --Claude
